findings.text: follow-on: this probe, and about ten sibling probes in the same new directory, re-declare a local `time_call` that returns the median of warm device-blocked calls — a timing primitive the repository already owns at benchmarks/forward_solve_throughput.py:388; harmless for a one-shot prototype run in isolation, but it is a duplicated primitive rather than an extension of the owner, and the two signatures (list of walls plus compile seconds vs a median/min/max dict) will drift.

follow-on: the assertion compares the two members of the same identical-input vmap call (paired[0][0] against paired[0][1]), so both sides move together and a deterministic regression in join_levels leaves it green; it verifies vmap determinism, not the join rule's correctness, and the join rule's boundary parity is recorded in the receipt but not asserted here.
